fusions.name: Run It to Ground
fusions.desc: Sends the pack after one enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 25 damage.

fusions.name: Flush the Quarry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 rats to flush your quarry, each dealing 10 damage and stunning what it hits for 1 second, with a 60% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunting Chorus
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Smell of the Dying
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%.
